header.name: Nirav Patel
header.shortAbout: AI Engineer · 5 years across software, analytics, and AI

summary: Engineer with 5 years across software, analytics, and AI who takes AI solutions from a customer’s problem to production, not just from a spec to code. Builds GenAI applications end to end - LLM agents, RAG and retrieval, prompt and context design, model selection, evaluation, and observability - on Python with Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, and Azure OpenAI, integrated against enterprise APIs, databases, and document repositories on AWS and GCP. Has owned products from design through production for identity-verification and compliance customers, translating ambiguous requirements into working systems and acting as the technical point of contact for what gets built and why. Turns one-off wins into reusable, guardrailed building blocks so customer teams and less-technical colleagues become self-sufficient. Comfortable troubleshooting across the full stack - applications, models, pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure - and partnering with security and compliance so every deployment meets data-protection, access-control, and Responsible AI standards.

workExperience.title: AI Engineer
workExperience.description:
• Owned the Financial Screening product from design to production for identity-verification and lending customers - parsing raw bank statements into verified income, cashflow trends, and recurring obligations scored into an explainable approve/review/decline verdict, with synthetic-document forensics flagging AI-generated paystubs in 412ms at under 2% false positives.
• Architected and delivered a four-agent production suite end to end - autonomous verification, compliance adjudication, agent-gateway integration, and deepfake detection - on LangGraph and Amazon Bedrock Agents, with multi-step reasoning over checkpointed shared state, graceful fallbacks, and Bedrock Guardrails enforcing safety policies.
• Built Claire, a conversational AI copilot in the customer dashboard - querying live session records, risk scores, and monitoring alerts in plain English with tenant-isolated data access, handling decline explanations, anomaly analysis, and compliance narratives, and surfacing distribution shifts and velocity spikes proactively.
• Delivered grounded retrieval for a customer-facing support agent at scale - RAG on Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases with hybrid search (BM25, dense vectors, RRF, Cohere re-ranking), every answer returning its evidence chain and confidence interval - and DeepAI, a natural-language analytics layer turning business questions into structured queries and regulatory-ready exports.
• Built an MCP server and agent gateway integrating the platform with customer and internal systems as a provider-agnostic tool surface, with multi-provider routing across Claude, Bedrock, and Azure OpenAI making model choice a configuration decision rather than a code change.
• Deployed and operated production services on AWS - asynchronous FastAPI microservices at 350ms p50 on ECS Fargate with CI/CD - and established the evaluation and observability practice: LangSmith tracing, automated eval pipelines, retrieval regression suites in CI, and drift detection on Prometheus and Grafana; cut mean time to resolution 40% and delivery timelines 20-25%.

workExperience.title: Data Analyst

• Streamlined data collection and reporting in SQL and Python, automating data pipelines to cut manual reporting effort 60-70% and support ad-hoc analysis of campaign and feature impact.

• Developed an end-user training program and supporting documentation for newly built tools, shortening onboarding time 25% and reducing support requests from operations teams.

• Collaborated with senior developers on feature delivery, customization, and testing across concurrent client projects, improving delivery efficiency.
